## Failures and corrections retained

1. Initial fixture assumed the requester was not a deployed receiving owner; historical seed deploys that member to both units. Changed rejection assertion to a genuinely undeployed subject. Another presumed hidden sibling belonged to the receiver; created a separate requester-owned private sibling.
2. Expanded third-contribution isolation initially found legitimate independent read access from the receiver's source-unit deployment. The receiving-only fixture expires that historical source deployment; both original accepted work and third-party denial now pass. No production access rule was weakened.
3. Two initial frontend tests were stopped by native required-field validation before reaching their intended server-failure branch. Filled valid proposal fields and explicitly submitted the reconfirmation guard test; six interface tests pass. A Windows-encoded inserted separator in a test selector was removed through a semantic label regex.
4. Browser selectors initially matched disclosure+button, parent+request criteria and agreement+task links. Scoped by rendered summary/region/link; no application invariant changed. A collapsed replacement form made the only refresh button inaccessible: added a visible agreement refresh, protected during pending commands, and retained stale drafts without leaving an empty response form after success.
5. First preview restart lacked the owned log directory. Created node_modules/.cache and relaunched the verified owned process; preview restored. Later refresh loaded current schema/fixtures. No unrelated process stopped.
6. Initial production build failed on three newly inserted cp1252 characters in TaskDetail/DeliverablePage/Overview; normalized only invalid UTF-8 bytes. Detector initially could not scan those files. Full frontend checks, build, detector and browser rerun PASS. Failed output remains in frontend ledger.
7. pnpm test:overview does not exist; ran node scripts/test-overview.cjs PASS. Earlier P14 browser text assertion now matched both saved prose and the editor; scoped to Task details and reran PASS. Both failures retained here/command logs.
8. Render review found a view select and nested request disclosure missing the existing 44px styling. Reused incumbent styles and added measured browser assertions; final browser/lint/typecheck/build pass.

9. Initial commit failed because user.name/user.email were unconfigured. Reused the established identity from the four preceding branch checkpoints through per-command Git options; no global or repository configuration was changed.
